documents.title: Range Rules
documents.desc: The authoritative document governing all range use at Austin Rifle Club. All members must read and follow these rules.

documents.title: Firearm Use by Range
documents.desc: Quick reference guide specifying which types of firearms are permitted on each individual range.

documents.title: Quick Reference
documents.desc: A condensed flyer highlighting the most important safety rules. Great to review before each visit.

documents.title: Steel Target Quick Reference
documents.desc: Details on which ranges permit steel targets and what conditions and distances apply per range.

keyRules.label: Suppressors / SBR / SBS
keyRules.note: Legal NFA items (suppressors, short-barreled rifles, SBS) are permitted.

keyRules.label: Holster Draw
keyRules.note: Allowed on select ranges only. All shots must be taken with an acquired sight picture.

keyRules.label: Steel Targets
keyRules.note: Permitted on certain ranges under specific conditions — see Steel Quick Reference.

keyRules.label: Badge Gate Entry
keyRules.note: Scan your badge every entry and exit. Do not tailgate or allow others to follow you through.

keyRules.label: Machine Gun / Simulated Auto
keyRules.note: Prohibited. Includes bump stocks, FRTs, switches, and any simulated-auto fire devices.

keyRules.label: Movement While Shooting
keyRules.note: Not permitted except during a sanctioned match or ARC-authorized practice.

keyRules.label: No Range Reservations
keyRules.note: General use ranges cannot be reserved. Only calendar-listed events reserve ranges.

keyRules.label: No Supplies On-Site
keyRules.note: No targets, ammo, or accessories are sold at the range. Bring everything you need.
